name: Esplanade Main Stage
note: Yerba Buena Gardens: OSM building=no, amenity=theatre, 'outdoor ground level performance stage'. A 12 m stone oval deck, not an apartment block as the list guessed; no photograph exists and no source shows a canopy, so none is drawn.

name: 555 Montgomery Street
note: 1983 SOM, 18 floors, pale precast with punched square windows and notched corners. Kept OSM's 93 m; skyscrapercenter gives 86 m to roof.

name: Intercontinental San Francisco
note: 2008 Patri Merker / Hornberger + Worstell, 888 Howard: 32 floors of rounded blue-green glass bays on a buff precast podium with a deep entrance canopy.

name: 745 Buchanan Street
note: Former church, now the Korean American Community Center / Addis Kidan Lutheran: a one-storey grey nave with tall arched windows, a pointed-arch porch and a spirelet. OSM has no height; ~10 m from the photographs.

name: Children's Creativity Museum
note: Zeum (1998, Adele Naude Santos), 221 Fourth on the Yerba Buena roof terrace: two storeys of pale mauve stucco with deep cantilevered eyebrow canopies. Not brick, as the list's style had it.
